test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in direct speech.

They said that they had been waiting for the bus for over an hour.

options.text: “We had waited for the bus for over an hour,” they said.
“We have been waiting for the bus for over an hour,” they said.
“We are waiting for the bus for over an hour,” they said.
“We waited for the bus for over an hour,” they said.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** They said that they had been waiting for the bus for over an hour.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"that they had been waiting" becomes "We have been waiting"**
 
 
• Indirect statement "that they had been waiting" is converted to direct statement "We have been waiting."
 
• Pronoun "they" is changed to &qu
